steps.description: Synthetic broker receipt recovery survives a lost acquire response without a delivery row or run record; live processes renew, failed releases retain the journal, and confirmed drain retries release with a positive acknowledgement. ITP-11 also verifies two synthetic ready OS holders carry one canonical gemini-reviewer identity; independent pools cannot acquire a third lease, cleanup/drain failures retain the durable fence until readiness succeeds, an in-flight release retains its local receipt during concurrent readiness, a terminal pre-spawn record without a PGID allows re-admission, and failed release immediately isolates its drained holder and starts authenticated recovery. No credentials, live broker, enrollment or live provider calls.

REMEDBRANCH-01 verifies unresolved remediation head metadata holds pending without a worker or round charge and recovery carries the resolved branch; settled clean reviews bypass branch reads and legacy holds, and unchanged workspace HEADs reject publication debt inferred from reply hashes. HAMNOREREVIEW-01 verifies the retired handoff helper requests no review, releases its dispatch lease for hammer retry, and the full reviewed-to-built range passes the real range and eligibility predicates before a disposable Git merge. BRANCHPROBE-01 verifies null head metadata uses Git confirmation, unknown reads defer without consuming budget, and recovery dispatches; unidentified forks stop for operator inspection after six hours without charging launch budget or continuing same-head probes. Terminal scratch cleanup preserves a draining recorded process and removes its private pytest tree after exit; aged terminal cwd-timeout recovery; oldest-first scratch cursor resumes across passes and restarts with independent ledger timeouts; terminal no-merge lease/capacity release and wake re-arm; armed auto-merge retains ownership inside the 30-minute lease window and releases at expiry; unreadable fresh launches reserve capacity.

HAMREDCI-01: proven final-round red-CI reason admission works with and without non-blocking findings; blocking or unknown blocking findings and structural holds still refuse that route. HAMPROVCI-01 verifies failed-CI admission and direct round requeue preserve a completed comment-only final handoff and its strict hammer starting-base edge, even at the round cap; suppression without the canonical finalRound marker retains ordinary requeue handling. LEASELIVE-01: offline handoff smoke retains a 45-minute running closer lease, releases a terminal launch and exercises the execution-ceiling fallback without live state. LEASEDEADPID-01: dead pending watcher ownership releases final comment findings to hammer without lease writes; live pending ownership waits; foreign-host pending ownership expires by age without local PID probes using a numeric epoch-millisecond clock. CI-repair wake and ownership admit terminal failed conclusions on a stale reviewed head; an empty same-head verdict does not establish repair ownership; closer refusal settles matching reclaimable pending leases, removes generated unlaunched prompts, and preserves fresh live-PID ownership. CEILINGPUSH-01 also verifies green moved-head ceiling wake admission independent of legacy exhaustion reason/snapshot and idempotent routing with the original reviewed head.

HAMCLOSEWAIT-01 verifies an existing final-round wait advances to a retained launch timestamp: no page at twenty minutes, exhaustion without progress after thirty; repeated future-dated timestamps cannot postpone a stall page. HAMCLOSEWAIT-02 verifies a running background launch borrows a fixed window, successful settlement persists the launch timestamp across SQLite reopen, refusal restores original debt, and either path pages only once. Packaging stops retain unchanged deterministic refusals and fence ownerless recovery even with packaging-only audit history, without another page; changed inputs release persisted refusals. Production preflight retires legacy holds without audit history, and mixed transient predicates prevent pure infrastructure classification. Includes distinct fleet-stop-active and fleet-stop-merge-kill reasons, uncached ledger-independent refusal and matching file removal using disposable roots; activation also requires the registered watcher to adopt the reader and old hammers to drain.
